title: Describing Words
introduction: Practise describing words with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: Describing words tell us what something is like, for example its colour or size.
rules: Put a describing word before a noun: a small cat.
You can also use it after is: The cat is small.

grammar.description: a red ball, a big bag
